stem: A pinhole camera is a closed box with a tiny hole in its front. Light from the top and bottom of a tree passes through the hole \(H\) and forms an upside-down image on the back of the box, as shown. The tree is 6 meters tall and is 15 meters from the hole. The image is 4 centimeters tall. The tree and the back of the box are both vertical. What is the distance, in centimeters, from the hole to the back of the box? Note: Figure not drawn to scale.
solution: The tree and the image are parallel, and the light rays cross at \(H\), so the two triangles formed are similar (vertical angles and alternate interior angles).
Work in centimeters: the tree is 600 cm tall and 1,500 cm from the hole. \(\frac{d}{1{,}500} = \frac{4}{600}\).
verify:
P=figure['points']
d=lambda a,b: sqrt((P[a][0]-P[b][0])**2+(P[a][1]-P[b][1])**2)
ang=lambda a,v,b: N(acos(((P[a][0]-P[v][0])*(P[b][0]-P[v][0])+(P[a][1]-P[v][1])*(P[b][1]-P[v][1]))/(d(a,v)*d(b,v)))*180/pi)
assert figure['not_to_scale'] and P['T'][0]==P['U'][0] and P["T'"][0]==P["U'"][0]
assert abs((P['T'][1]-P['H'][1])*(P["T'"][0]-P['H'][0])-(P["T'"][1]-P['H'][1])*(P['T'][0]-P['H'][0]))<0.01
d=symbols('d')
ans=solve(Eq(d/1500,Rational(4,600)),d)[0]
assert Rational(spr_answers[0])==ans==10
